changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwfinancialdocumentsequence AS SELECT fds.id, fds.facility_id, fds.document_type, fds.period_key, fds.last_number, fds.version, fds.created_by, fds.created_date, fds.last_modified_by, fds.last_modified_date FROM public.financial_document_sequence fds;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocumentsequence TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwfinancialdocumentsequence FROM report_user;
